posts.content_md:
Dear friends and colleagues,

Our web site has been updated. Publication of the course "25 holography lessons" has been finished! Final lessons (#22-25, subsection "Reflection copy recording") have been published in "Technology" section of our web site.

#22 - [Scheme of transmission hologram copying](http://www.holography.ru/les22eng.htm)

#23 - [Adjustment of the copying scheme](http://www.holography.ru/les23eng.htm)

#24 - [Adjustment of beams ratio and determination of hologram's exposure time](http://www.holography.ru/les24eng.htm)

#25 - [Reflection copy recording](http://www.holography.ru/les25eng.htm)

Lessons give you detailed review of a professional holographic process: recording of transmission and reflection holograms using Denisyuk and Leith-Upatnieks schemes; continuous-wave and pulse holography and so on. Now you can study all our lessons on Holography.Ru!

See ["Technology" section](http://www.holography.ru/techeng.htm) of Holography.Ru

posts.content_md:
Sergey, I can see you (your team) have put a lot of time into those lessons and they are very good. They are easy to follow, have lots of diagrams and are presented on a very basic level such that almost anyone can understand the concepts.

I highly recommend them, especially for the beginner.

John

Thank you, John. The main point of our lessons is dedication of beginners and professionals to some secrets of professional holographic process. We discussed this topic with the author of holographic lessons (Sergey Vorobyov) several years ago, in order to summarize our experience, to share it with others. I hope, it's worth the reader's attention to observe.
